page: Microsoft Azure E2s_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance belonging to the Esv6 server family. It is configured with 2 vCPUs mapped to a single physical core of an Intel Xeon 8573C processor running at 4.2 GHz. The architecture is x86_64, utilizing Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization with dedicated CPU allocation. The system features 16.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, but it is Premium Storage capable for external disk attachments. The processor supports advanced instruction sets, including Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX, AVX512F, AVX512_VNNI, AVX_VNNI, AVX512_BF16) and Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX_TILE, AMX_INT8), alongside cryptographic acceleration via AES, VAES, and SHA_NI.

Benchmark data reveals a significant contrast between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core execution is relatively strong, as demonstrated by a Geekbench single-core score of 2149.0 and average ratings in single-threaded stress-ng CPU performance, gzip compression, and bzip3 decompression. However, multi-core and multi-threaded workloads show limitations, with a Geekbench multi-core score of 2641.0 and a poor stress-ng multi-core rating. Memory bandwidth is also constrained, with uncached read and write speeds of 21.51 GB/sec and 14.04 GB/sec respectively, both falling into the lower performance tiers. Database operations and Redis SET benchmarks also reflect weak throughput, with Redis achieving 2.56 million operations per second.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the E2s_v6 provides a low-cost entry point into the memory-optimized tier, offering a high memory capacity relative to its small vCPU footprint without the expense of larger multi-core instances. This resource density makes it suitable for memory-bound but compute-light workloads. Recommended applications include small-scale databases, caching layers, basic text processing, and lightweight web serving. It is less suited for compute-intensive tasks, software compilation, or heavy multi-threaded processing due to its single-core physical constraint.
description: The Microsoft Azure E2s_v6 is an x86_64 memory-optimized virtual machine powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8573C processor running at 4.2 GHz. It features 2 vCPUs across 1 physical core, 16.0 GB of RAM (8.0 GB per vCPU), and no local storage, though it is Premium Storage capable. While single-core performance is strong, with a Geekbench single-core score of 2149.0, multi-core benchmarks and memory bandwidth are relatively weak, as shown by a Geekbench multi-core score of 2641.0 and uncached read speeds of 21.51 GB/sec. This instance offers a qualitative cost-efficient entry point for memory-intensive workloads with low compute requirements. It is best suited for small databases, caching layers, and lightweight web serving.
